steps.title: Step 1 of 7
steps.instruction: In the Blog Hub, click the Posts tab to see all your blog posts.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Posts tab visible on screen

steps.title: Step 2 of 7
steps.instruction: Click the + New Post button in the top-right corner. This opens the creation page.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — New Post button visible

steps.title: Step 3 of 7
steps.instruction: You have two options: Write from scratch opens the Blog Editor directly. Generate with AI uses AI to create a draft.
steps.actionTaken: Instruction references content editing (verified page context)
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Instruction references content editing (verified page context)

steps.title: Step 4 of 7
steps.instruction: If you chose "Write from scratch": The Blog Editor opens with a blank post. Enter your Title, write your content in the editor, and add images as needed.
steps.justification: Described element not visible on current screen: Title field not found

steps.title: Step 5 of 7
steps.instruction: If you chose "Generate with AI": Enter your topic, select tone and keywords, then click Generate AI Prompt. Copy the prompt to your AI assistant, paste the JSON response, then click Save Blog Post to save and open in Blog Editor.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Save/Publish button visible: "4PostsWrite & publish"

steps.title: Step 6 of 7
steps.instruction: In the Blog Editor, configure: Tags, Hero Image, and Description (SEO).
steps.justification: Described element not visible on current screen: Metadata fields not found

steps.title: Step 7 of 7
steps.instruction: Set Status to Draft, In Review, or Published. Click Save Changes.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Save/Publish button visible: "4PostsWrite & publish"

flows.name: Translate a postTranslate a post to another language using AI or manual tools

steps.title: Step 1 of 8
steps.instruction: Go to Posts and locate the post you want to translate.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Translate control visible

steps.title: Step 2 of 8
steps.instruction: Click the 🌐 translate icon next to the post. A dialog will appear.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Translate control visible

steps.title: Step 3 of 8
steps.instruction: Choose ✨ Translate with AI for automatic translation, or Translate manually to use your own tools.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Translate control visible

steps.title: Step 4 of 8
steps.instruction: If you chose AI: the editor opens with the translated content. Review the title, description, and content for accuracy.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Translate control visible

steps.title: Step 5 of 8
steps.instruction: If you chose manual: the editor opens with the original content. Click Translation Assistant to use the translation helper, or translate directly.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Translate control visible

steps.title: Step 6 of 8
steps.instruction: Make any necessary edits to the translation. Images are automatically preserved in their original positions.
steps.actionTaken: Instruction references content editing (verified page context)
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Instruction references content editing (verified page context)

steps.title: Step 7 of 8
steps.instruction: Verify the Slug is language-appropriate (e.g., ends in -en or -fr). Update the Description (SEO) if needed.
steps.justification: Described element not visible on current screen: Metadata fields not found

steps.title: Step 8 of 8
steps.instruction: Change Status to Published when ready. Click Save Changes.
steps.justification: Instruction makes sense — Save/Publish button visible: "4PostsWrite & publish"
